notes: A variable whose binding is statically visible now compiles to a constant number of parent hops plus one property access, instead of a per-frame name scan on every read. The compile-time scope chain mirrors the runtime frame chain for method-rooted code; block bodies compile eagerly under their enclosing chain; and every name the static chain cannot see — a do-it temp reached from a block, an instance variable, a global — keeps the full runtime fallback, because a resolver that guessed would break exactly the cases it cannot prove.
